title: Which Pattern Is This? A Recognition Quiz
oneLiner: Read a short scenario or snippet and name the design pattern, then see the signals that give it away and the sibling it is usually confused with.
keyTakeaway: Patterns are recognized by intent, not by shape. A class that wraps another and forwards calls could be an Adapter, a Decorator or a Proxy; the question that settles it is what the wrapper is for. Train yourself to ask that question first.
explanation:
Interviewers rarely ask you to define a pattern. They describe a problem or show you code and wait to see whether you recognize it, and whether you can explain why it is that pattern and not its closest sibling. This quiz drills exactly that, in the same format as the Pattern Recognition Drill for algorithms.

Each question is a short scenario or a snippet. Pick the pattern; the options always include the one it is most often confused with. After answering you see the signals that identify it and how to tell it from that sibling. The end screen lists every question you missed, with a link to the lesson that covers it, and lets you rerun only the misses.
